name: Xoi
summary: Xôi is the careful morning on the city portal’s 24 November 2022 page, and one of the dishes Báo Nghệ An names on đường Hồ Sỹ Dương at night. A topping was not printed.
origin: Vinh. The 24 November 2022 city page puts a portion in the morning. Báo Nghệ An puts it on Hồ Sỹ Dương at night.
howToEat: Order a portion in the morning, or late on Hồ Sỹ Dương. The city portal and Báo Nghệ An do not say what is on the rice. A price is Check on arrival.
where: The center in the morning. Đường Hồ Sỹ Dương at night. A closing hour was not printed. Check on arrival.
